body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34104
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1690

## What changed

Reproduced the reported controller crash on the prepared base: with four allocated slots, active workers `[0, 1]`, reserved sockets `[None, None]`, and `bootstrap_room=2`, the scheduler selected `workers[2]` and raised `AttributeError` in `sock_send`.

The scheduler now maps the bootstrap room through `_active_workers`, matching the active routing domain already used by round-robin, and raises a clear error if there are no active workers.

Regression coverage includes:

- the exact reserved-slot `None` socket failure;
- sparse active worker indices, verifying logical active-rank mapping;
- an empty active-worker domain;
- the existing bootstrap-room, missing-room, and externally routed rank cases.

An open upstream candidate exists at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34105 and has since expanded into broader elastic-topology work. This mirror PR stays narrow to the original reserved-slot report on the recorded base.

## Reproduction and validation

Failing before the source fix:

`/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e6974907a585/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_data_parallel_controller.py::TestFollowBootstrapRoomScheduler`

Result: 3 failed, 3 passed. The issue-specific case raised `AttributeError: NoneType object has no attribute send_pyobj`.

Passing after the fix:

`/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e6974907a585/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_data_parallel_controller.py`

Result: 20 passed.

`git diff --check` also passes.

## Limitations

No live multi-worker disaggregated serving deployment or model-weight execution was run. This defect is deterministic CPU-side routing before worker/GPU execution, so the assigned gfx950 was not used and no GPU correctness claim is made. No native code changed, so no native rebuild was performed. Full evidence and structured claims are under `reports/j-e6974907a585/`.
